name: drydock
description: Drydock — the engineering AI workbench: contained coding agents, blast-radius approvals, cross-project review.

commands.title: Isolated Run: Run Isolated Agent Prompt
Isolated Run: Probe Codex App Server Transport

drydock.stateRoot.markdownDescription: Root directory for product state (SQLite event store, disposable workspaces). Leave empty to use `~/.drydock`. Changing this requires a window reload.

drydock.deniedPaths.markdownDescription: Absolute paths excluded from runtime mounts, diff snapshots, and access-request approval. A mount intersecting a denied path (in either direction) is refused. Changing this requires a window reload.

drydock.disableDefaultDeniedPaths.markdownDescription: **Not recommended.** By default, sensitive home-directory config roots (`~/.ssh`, `~/.aws`, `~/.gnupg`, `~/.kube`, `~/.azure`, `~/.docker`) are merged into `#drydock.deniedPaths#` so the agent can never mount them, even via an approved access request. Enabling this removes that protection — an agent could then be granted read or write access to your SSH keys, cloud credentials, and other secrets. Leave this off unless you have a specific reason and understand the risk. Changing this requires a window reload.

drydock.runtime.pathAdditions.markdownDescription: Extra directories prepended to `PATH` when Drydock runs runtime tools (`sbx` and the agent CLIs). Use this when a GUI-launched VS Code can't find the Docker credential helper or `sbx` companions your terminal can — e.g. `C:\\Program Files\\Docker\\Docker\\resources\\bin`. Drydock already adds the standard Docker Desktop / Docker Sandbox bin dirs; list any non-standard install locations here. Changing this requires a window reload.

drydock.runtime.env.markdownDescription: Additional environment variables to set for Drydock's runtime tools (`sbx`, agent CLIs), as name→value pairs. Overrides inherited values. Useful for injecting things the extension host is missing, e.g. `DOCKER_CONFIG` or a `DOCKER_HOST`. Changing this requires a window reload.

drydock.runtime.copyEnv.markdownDescription: Names of environment variables to explicitly forward from the extension host to runtime tools. Drydock already inherits the full host environment, so this is a safeguard/diagnostic: if a listed variable is missing at load, Drydock logs a warning so you can tell your terminal's session isn't reaching the extension host. Changing this requires a window reload.

drydock.runtime.appServerInactivityTimeo.markdownDescription: Quiet-turn detector for Codex app-server turns: if the app-server sends no activity for this many milliseconds, Drydock logs a stall diagnostic (the turn is **not** auto-failed). The chat also offers a "Give it a poke?" nudge after ~30s of silence to try to break a standoff gracefully. Raise this if your turns legitimately run long silent operations (big builds/test suites); set to `0` to disable the diagnostic. Changing this requires a window reload.

drydock.agentIdleThresholdMinutes.markdownDescription: Minutes without delegated-agent activity before Drydock labels that agent idle in the visibility UI.

drydock.codeBlockWordWrap.markdownDescription: Wrap long lines inside chat transcript code blocks. Disable to keep horizontal scrolling.
